Pakistan warns Afghanistan on cross-border terrorism

Pakistan has issued a warning to Afghanistan, stating that terrorism is a 'red-line' and that action will be taken against cross-border threats. The specifics of the potential action were not detailed. Separately, US Senator Marco Rubio acknowledged Pakistan's concerns regarding terrorism but did not provide firm US backing against Afghanistan.
